findings.detail: Static code matches independent lognormal BMI/HbA1c, scaled-beta glucose, and independent uniform integer ages within eight fixed female-by-age cells. Exactly 375 rows per cell gives 3000 rows. The rows are stratified rather than identically distributed; equal-cell population moments are stated correctly.

Independent closed-form calculations reproduce all five first/second moments. Lognormals exponentiate linear Gaussian variables and have finite polynomial moments; beta glucose and demographics are bounded. Beta shapes are positive. The documented nearest-interior-float glucose guard respects 0<glucose<126 mg/dL. Positive predictor variances and assumed factorization give nonsingular population regressions and zero requested slopes, residual variance 0.09, and RMS 0.3.

All 17 candidate evidence items exactly equal the registered scoped source records. Six selected marginal anchors and the protocol factor 18 conversion trace numerically. Direct HbA1c percent summaries are selected explicitly; alternate IFCC-derived summaries and complementary sex representations are not extra evidence. Individual SD is not estimator uncertainty. E0 supplies zero non-marginal operations, so empty uptake is valid.
